r1.content: Three tips to speed up your Python for-loop: move invariant computations out of the loop, prefer local variable bindings, and use a comprehension or built-in like map/filter when you do not need side effects.

r2.content: DNS resolution turns a human-readable hostname into an IP address. When you type a URL, your machine first checks its local resolver cache; on a miss it queries a recursive resolver, which walks from the root servers to the TLD nameservers to the authoritative server for the domain. The authoritative server returns the A or AAAA record, and the result is cached for the record's TTL so subsequent lookups are fast.
